families.title: Bone Spring 3 / XY / Wolfcamp A — the XY squeeze
families.note: Since 2026-10-22 WCXY + WCA_1 + WCA_2 are scored as ONE WCA bench, XY → B1 (rule A); this panel is kept as the naming evidence for that decision and for a possible WCA_1 / WCA_2 surface (rule C, later).

families.title: Wolfcamp B2 / C / D — what the B2 → C interval holds
families.note: WCC is scored against B2 → C (relabel, 2026-10-22). This panel shows the same interval also holds WCB_2 (straddling the B2 top) and much of WCD (near the C top): the WCB_2 | WCC split is the operator boundary a surface inside B2 → C would need to carry for re-landing. WOLFCAMP_D is suspect — its line is dashed.

families.title: Avalon — Upper / Middle / Lower
families.note: No Middle Avalon surface exists; operator Middle Avalon tops sit ~110 ft above AVALON2 (geologist, 29 wells, MAD 24 ft) — drawn as the dotted line at −110.
